This is egui-winit 0.33.3, from https://github.com/emilk/egui, licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0 as recorded in Cargo.toml. The paste handler in src/lib.rs forwards a Ctrl/Cmd+V key event when no text is available, allowing rsStudio to read an image from the clipboard. Text paste retains the upstream behavior. Remove this patch when the upstream integration exposes image paste events.
